text: Announcement9 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com 1.3.6 Preview - Enlightened Ayanad Accessories Second post in our series of features on Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents Enlightened Ayanad accessories and more. In the upcoming 1.3.6 patch, Ayanad accessories can be upgraded to Enlightened Ayanad Accessories through the power of Runestones. Runestone Talisman A stone etched with a powerful runic symbol. The energy of the rune pulls you towards the Ayanad Library. The scriptures in the Ayanad Library had once mentioned how Rowan Alexander had spent years of research into runestones that could be embedded into accessories to transcend its abilities. A power that could even rival the gods, Alexander destroyed the entirety of his research once Kyrios sought the power for himself. Spend 10 labor to unlock the secrets of Ayanad. Runestones were discovered by the scholars of the Ayanad Library and were once researched and used by Alexander in pursuit of great power capable of unlocking the hidden potential of items. Runestones resonate with the magic sealed within an item, drawing its dormant power to the surface. When applied to an Ayanad accessory, the Runestone breaks through the limitations placed upon its enchantments, allowing the accessory to manifest abilities previously beyond its reach. The process does not replace the accessory's existing enchantments. Instead, it awakens and amplifies the power already contained within them, resulting in an Enlightened Ayanad Accessory. Enlightened Accessories Applying a Runestone to any Ayanad accessory will grant the corresponding Enlightened version. The grade of the Ayanad accessory is retained. Throughout the post, there will be three types of enchantments: Lunasigil: Applied to any Enlightened ring or earring. Grants stats. Charm: Applied to costume, grants the benefits of the Enlightenment 2-set that you pick. Mark: Applied to any Enlightened Necklace, modifies a skill. By default, Enlightened Ayanad Accessories will not have any stats assigned to the item. The equip effect is retained when upgrading from Ayanad to Enlightened. Enlightened Ayanad Wave Earring Earring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Decreases received damage -2.75%. Enlightened Ayanad Wave Ring Ring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Decreases Cast Time -2.75%. Enlightened Ayanad Wave Necklace Necklace An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Magic Defense Penetration +937 To assign stats to Enlightened Ayanad accessories, you will need to use a Perfect Lunasigil on the Enlightened accessory. Perfect Lunasigils are stats only and is not related to the 2-set Enlightenment section. Applying a Perfect Lunasigil on top of an existing enchantment will replace the existing enchantment. With the Enlightenment set bonus active, the player will enchant their costume with its corresponding Charm to receive the effect. Costume Charms Options Name Effect Flame Charm Restore 100 HP when blocking, parrying or evading an attack. Gale Charm Critical hits increase movement speed by 3%. Stacks up to 10 times. Decreases movement speed by -15%. Earth Charm +2 Max Abyssal Charges Meadow Charm Abyssal charges no longer decay. Wave Charm +10 Post-Cast Mana Regen Life Charm Increases the rank of the following skills by +1: - The full list is still being decided. Increases mana consumption of all skills by 30%. Lightning Charm Increases gliding speed by 50%. Increases gliding recovery by +1 seconds. Two examples: A meadow ring and a meadow earring will enable Meadow Enlightenment. With a Meadow Charm enchanted on your costume, then you will receive the meadow effects as listed. A flame ring and flame earring will enable Flame Enlightenment. With a Flame Charm enchanted on your costume, then you will receive the flame effects as listed. These effects may be subject to change based on feedback. Enlightened Ayanad Meadow Ring Ring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases max mana +653. Enlightened Ayanad Earth Earring Earring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Magic Defense +299. Enlightened Ayanad Wave Earring Earring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Decreases received damage -2.75%. Enlightened Ayanad Flame Earring Earring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Evasion +2.75%. Enlightened Ayanad Life Ring Ring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Skill Damage +2.75%. Enlightened Ayanad Lightning Ring Ring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases max health +899. Enlightened Ayanad Gale Ring Ring An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Ignores 468 of target's Defense. Equipping two rings or two earrings of the same Ayanad type will NOT activate the set bonus. Enlightened Necklaces Enlightened Ayanad Meadow Necklace Necklace An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Critical Heal Rate +2.75%. Enlightened Ayanad Life Necklace Necklace An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases max mana +1130. Enlightened Ayanad Wave Necklace Necklace An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Magic Defense Penetration +937. Enlightened Ayanad Earth Necklace Necklace An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed. Increases Magic Defense +510. Necklaces do not have set bonuses like rings and earrings do, but still utilize Perfect Lunasigils to grant them the desired stats. In addition to Perfect Lunasigils, necklaces can be frosted with either a Radiant or a Hollow Mark, which will modify certain skills into their Radiant or Hollow variants. At Discovery, there will be a total of 10 Radiant Marks and 10 Hollow Marks to choose from. More information and previews on these Radiant and Hollow skills will be shown in a future blog post. Applying a Skill Mark on top of another will replace the existing one. Applying a Skill Mark on top of a Perfect Lunasigil will replace the Perfect Lunasigil. Radiant and Hollow Marks can be frosted onto Enlightened World Boss and Dungeon Necklaces. World Boss and Dungeon Necklaces Enlightened Ayanad necklaces can now be fused with existing World Boss and Dungeon accessories to create a corresponding Enlightened version. To fuse the Enlightened Ayanad necklace of choice with Storm Caller's Hoop, an enchantment scroll is required. Dread Enchantment Scroll Talisman A scroll imbued with the ink of the Kraken. Forges the properties of the Storm Caller's Hoop onto an Enlightened Necklace. The grade of the Enlightened Necklace is transferred onto the combination. Requirements: - Dread Enchantment Scroll - Storm Caller's Hoop - Enlightened Necklace Handicrafts: Spend 10 labor imbuing an Enlightened accessory. Announcement9 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
1.3.6 Preview - Enlightened Ayanad Accessories
Second post in our series of features on Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents Enlightened Ayanad accessories and more.

In the upcoming 1.3.6 patch, Ayanad accessories can be upgraded to Enlightened Ayanad Accessories through the power of Runestones.

Runestone
Talisman
A stone etched with a powerful runic symbol. The energy of the rune pulls you towards the Ayanad Library.
The scriptures in the Ayanad Library had once mentioned how Rowan Alexander had spent years of research into runestones that could be embedded into accessories to transcend its abilities.
A power that could even rival the gods, Alexander destroyed the entirety of his research once Kyrios sought the power for himself.
Spend 10 labor to unlock the secrets of Ayanad.

Runestones were discovered by the scholars of the Ayanad Library and were once researched and used by Alexander in pursuit of great power capable of unlocking the hidden potential of items.

Runestones resonate with the magic sealed within an item, drawing its dormant power to the surface. When applied to an Ayanad accessory, the Runestone breaks through the limitations placed upon its enchantments, allowing the accessory to manifest abilities previously beyond its reach.

The process does not replace the accessory's existing enchantments. Instead, it awakens and amplifies the power already contained within them, resulting in an Enlightened Ayanad Accessory.

Enlightened Accessories

Applying a Runestone to any Ayanad accessory will grant the corresponding Enlightened version. The grade of the Ayanad accessory is retained.

Throughout the post, there will be three types of enchantments:

  • Lunasigil: Applied to any Enlightened ring or earring. Grants stats.
  • Charm: Applied to costume, grants the benefits of the Enlightenment 2-set that you pick.
  • Mark: Applied to any Enlightened Necklace, modifies a skill.

By default, Enlightened Ayanad Accessories will not have any stats assigned to the item. The equip effect is retained when upgrading from Ayanad to Enlightened.

Enlightened Ayanad Wave Earring
Earring
An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed.
Decreases received damage -2.75%.
Enlightened Ayanad Wave Ring
Ring
An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed.
Decreases Cast Time -2.75%.
Enlightened Ayanad Wave Necklace
Necklace
An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed.
Increases Magic Defense Penetration +937

To assign stats to Enlightened Ayanad accessories, you will need to use a Perfect Lunasigil on the Enlightened accessory.

Perfect Lunasigils are stats only and is not related to the 2-set Enlightenment section.

Applying a Perfect Lunasigil on top of an existing enchantment will replace the existing enchantment.

Perfect Lunasigils Options

Perfect Gale Lunasigil +35 Agility

Enlightened Rings & Earrings

Set Bonuses

Ring and Earrings will now have 2-set bonuses which enables a specific Enlightenment.

With the Enlightenment set bonus active, the player will enchant their costume with its corresponding Charm to receive the effect.

Costume Charms Options

Name Effect
Flame Charm Restore 100 HP when blocking, parrying or evading an attack.

Decreases movement speed by -15%.
Earth Charm +2 Max Abyssal Charges

Wave Charm +10 Post-Cast Mana Regen
Life Charm Increases the rank of the following skills by +1:
- The full list is still being decided.
Increases mana consumption of all skills by 30%.
Lightning Charm Increases gliding speed by 50%.
Increases gliding recovery by +1 seconds.

Two examples:

A meadow ring and a meadow earring will enable Meadow Enlightenment. With a Meadow Charm enchanted on your costume, then you will receive the meadow effects as listed.

A flame ring and flame earring will enable Flame Enlightenment. With a Flame Charm enchanted on your costume, then you will receive the flame effects as listed.

These effects may be subject to change based on feedback.

Enlightened Necklaces

Enlightened Ayanad Meadow Necklace

Enlightened Ayanad Wave Necklace

Increases Magic Defense Penetration +937.
Enlightened Ayanad Earth Necklace
Necklace
An accessory that has had its potential fully unleashed.
Increases Magic Defense +510.

Necklaces do not have set bonuses like rings and earrings do, but still utilize Perfect Lunasigils to grant them the desired stats.

In addition to Perfect Lunasigils, necklaces can be frosted with either a Radiant or a Hollow Mark, which will modify certain skills into their Radiant or Hollow variants.

At Discovery, there will be a total of 10 Radiant Marks and 10 Hollow Marks to choose from.

More information and previews on these Radiant and Hollow skills will be shown in a future blog post.

Applying a Skill Mark on top of another will replace the existing one.

Applying a Skill Mark on top of a Perfect Lunasigil will replace the Perfect Lunasigil.

Radiant and Hollow Marks can be frosted onto Enlightened World Boss and Dungeon Necklaces.

World Boss and Dungeon Necklaces

Enlightened Ayanad necklaces can now be fused with existing World Boss and Dungeon accessories to create a corresponding Enlightened version.

To fuse the Enlightened Ayanad necklace of choice with Storm Caller's Hoop, an enchantment scroll is required.

Dread Enchantment Scroll
Talisman
A scroll imbued with the ink of the Kraken. Forges the properties of the Storm Caller's Hoop onto an Enlightened Necklace.
The grade of the Enlightened Necklace is transferred onto the combination.
Requirements:
- Dread Enchantment Scroll
- Storm Caller's Hoop
- Enlightened Necklace
Handicrafts: Spend 10 labor imbuing an Enlightened accessory.

Necklace

Enlightened variants of World Boss and Dungeon accessories will have their effects scaled based on the final grade.

Grade scaling begins at Divine. Celestial and below will retain their default effects.

In addition to World Boss and Dungeon accessories, we have also included the Library accessories:

  • Berserker Accessories
  • Oracle Accessories
  • Arcanist Accessories
  • Shadow Accessories

These accessories feature unique 3-set effects that require a ring, a necklace, and an earring to activate. The equip effects scale with grade.

Runestones were discovered by the scholars of the Ayanad Library and were once researched and used by Alexander in pursuit of great power capable of unlocking the hidden potential of items. Runestones resonate with the magic sealed within an item, drawing its dormant power to the surface. When applied to an Ayanad accessory, the Runestone breaks through the limitations placed upon its enchantments, allowing the accessory to manifest abilities previously beyond its reach. The process does not replace the accessory's existing enchantments. Instead, it awakens and amplifies the power already contained within them, resulting in an Enlightened Ayanad Accessory. == Enlightened Accessories == Applying a Runestone to any Ayanad accessory will grant the corresponding Enlightened version. The grade of the Ayanad accessory is retained. Throughout the post, there will be three types of enchantments: * Lunasigil: Applied to any Enlightened ring or earring. Grants stats. * Charm: Applied to costume, grants the benefits of the Enlightenment 2-set that you pick. * Mark: Applied to any Enlightened Necklace, modifies a skill. By default, Enlightened Ayanad Accessories will not have any stats assigned to the item. The equip effect is retained when upgrading from Ayanad to Enlightened.

Necklaces do not have set bonuses like rings and earrings do, but still utilize Perfect Lunasigils to grant them the desired stats. In addition to Perfect Lunasigils, necklaces can be frosted with either a Radiant or a Hollow Mark, which will modify certain skills into their Radiant or Hollow variants. At Discovery, there will be a total of 10 Radiant Marks and 10 Hollow Marks to choose from. More information and previews on these Radiant and Hollow skills will be shown in a future blog post.
Applying a Skill Mark on top of another will replace the existing one.
Applying a Skill Mark on top of a Perfect Lunasigil will replace the Perfect Lunasigil.
Radiant and Hollow Marks can be frosted onto Enlightened World Boss and Dungeon Necklaces.

== Enlightened Ayanad Armors == Through community feedback, Enlightened Ayanad Armors will no longer be included in the 1.3.6 update. We have made design changes to incorporate some of the unique effects originally planned for Lunasigil Armors into the accessory update instead. == Ayanad Changes == The following changes are currently being planned for existing Ayanad armors.
These changes are retroactive so you do not need to do anything to see the set bonuses reflected in 1.3.6.
These suggestions can be subject to additional feedback.
